items.title: BirdsEyeView integrates JBA Risk Management flood data into CERA platform
items.summary: Insurtech firm BirdsEyeView has partnered with JBA Risk Management to incorporate global flood hazard datasets into its CERA catastrophe modelling platform.

items.title: Soft insurance markets offer ideal conditions for captive feasibility work
items.summary: A quieter market cycle allows brokers and clients to evaluate captive structures without the pressure of difficult renewals, according to Artex Risk Solutions.

items.title: Pensions UK relaunches accreditation framework as Better Pensions Employer
items.summary: Pensions UK has renamed and restructured its employer pension accreditation process, shifting the focus towards pension adequacy.

items.title: BIBA and Intact Insurance launch new Start-Up Hub for brokers
items.summary: The British Insurance Brokers' Association has partnered with Intact Insurance to introduce a dedicated hub supporting new brokerage creation.

items.title: Hargreaves Lansdown head of fund research Kate Marshall departs
items.summary: Kate Marshall has left her role as head of fund research at Hargreaves Lansdown following recent departures within the research team.

items.title: Zurich raises Beazley integration synergy target to $1.8bn
items.summary: Zurich Insurance has increased its capital synergy expectations from the acquisition of Beazley, citing greater value in the integration.
